reply.description:
The user's rejection of the first round, quoted: "this should always be 1 because we always create a default record item". Count the default record item row of every category, whatever its amounts, so a new category shows 1.

Definition of Done: `pnpm vitest run src/summary/itemCount.test.ts` passes with a case for a new category (count 1); `pnpm lint` passes.
